title: 1815 Prairie's front steps show their treads under iron hand rails
items: The front steps of the Sears-Meeker house at 1815 Prairie Avenue had solid stone walls sweeping down each side. Both old photographs show something lighter: the ends of the steps showing along each side, with a thin iron hand rail above them running down to the stone post at the foot. On the south side the rail starts at a square stone post on the landing's corner, and a low iron rail runs from that post back to the house. The steps are now built that way. The basement door under the landing is still to come.
